sloka: रामस्य बाहुवीर्येण रक्षिता लक्ष्मणस्य च ।सुखं पारेसमुद्रस्य युध्येम विगतज्वराः ।। ७.३९.५ ॥
transliteration: rāmasya bāhuvīryeṇa rakṣitā lakṣmaṇasya ca ।sukhaṁ pāresamudrasya yudhyema vigatajvarāḥ ।। 7.39.5 ॥

translations.english: Protected by the strength of Rama's and Lakshmana's arms, they would have happily fought on the other side of the ocean, free from any anxiety.
